Technical SEO.title: Robots.txt Guide – Best Practices For Search & AI Crawlers
Technical SEO.summary: A practical guide covering how to configure robots.txt to manage AI training crawlers, search crawlers, and user-requested visits separately, while avoiding common crawl and indexing mistakes. Directly relevant for enterprise sites needing granular crawler control across both traditional and AI search bots.

Technical SEO.title: Google Explains How To Avoid CDN Migration SEO Problems
Technical SEO.summary: Google has published guidance on how to achieve the best SEO outcome when migrating to a CDN and avoid unexpected crawling problems. Directly actionable for enterprise teams managing infrastructure changes at scale.

Technical SEO.title: Google Hotel Campaigns Migrating To Search Campaigns For Travel
Technical SEO.summary: Google is migrating Hotel campaigns to new Search campaigns for Travel in Q4 2026, following an earlier migration of travel campaigns to the same format. Enterprise travel and cruise advertisers running Hotel campaigns need to prepare for this structural change.

Technical SEO.title: Rank Math SEO WordPress Plugin Hit By 16 Vulnerabilities In 2026
Technical SEO.summary: Rank Math SEO accumulated 16 security vulnerabilities in a single year, raising concerns about the plugin's security practices for the millions of sites using it. Enterprise SEO teams relying on this plugin for WordPress properties should audit their exposure.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Your Schema Markup Has a New Job. Is It Ready?
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: AI is changing how customers discover and evaluate brands, and enterprises need to move beyond rich results by developing the structured business context they publish for machines. This reframes schema markup as a core GEO signal rather than just a SERP enhancement.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Ads AI Max For Search For Travel Campaigns Help Docs
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google has released new help documentation for AI Max for Search for Travel campaigns as it begins migrating Travel campaigns to the new Search campaigns format. Travel and cruise advertisers need to review this documentation ahead of the forced migration.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Enterprise AI Governance Alone Cannot Protect Your Brand
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Generic enterprise AI governance frameworks may be insufficient to prevent off-brand AI-generated content from reaching customers, and marketing-specific guardrails are needed to close the gap. Relevant for enterprise teams scaling AI content production.

AI Search / GEO.title: HubSpot Lost 80% of Its Traffic – CMO Explains Why Revenue Kept Growing
AI Search / GEO.summary: HubSpot's CMO explains how the company sustained revenue growth despite losing the majority of its organic traffic, offering a real-world enterprise case study on decoupling business outcomes from traditional SEO traffic metrics in an AI search era.

AI Search / GEO.title: How I Am Approaching AI Search (And How You Should Too)
AI Search / GEO.summary: The article argues that chasing AI citation tactics misses the point, and that building a brand worth recommending by AI systems is more durable than optimizing for individual citation placements. A useful strategic reframe for enterprise GEO planning.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT Business Hub Offers a Glimpse of a Search Console for AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: ChatGPT's new Business Hub is described as an early Search Console equivalent for publishers, suggesting OpenAI is building visibility and performance tooling for brands appearing in ChatGPT answers. Directly relevant for teams tracking AI search presence.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT Citation Drops Look Like Unannounced Google Core Updates
AI Search / GEO.summary: Observed drops in ChatGPT citations are being compared to unannounced Google core updates in their unpredictability and scale. Enterprise SEO teams managing AI search visibility need to monitor for these fluctuations as they would traditional algorithm changes.

AI Search / GEO.title: How To Find The Questions Your Customers Ask AI (And Your Keyword Tools Miss)
AI Search / GEO.summary: The article outlines a methodology for mining sales calls, support tickets, and forum threads to surface questions customers ask AI that do not appear in standard keyword research tools. Actionable for enterprise content teams building AI-answer-optimized content plans.

AI Search / GEO.title: Generative Engine Optimization Software Global Market Forecast to 2036
AI Search / GEO.summary: A market forecast projects the GEO software category to reach 4.12 billion dollars by 2036, driven by AI visibility demands and brand risk concerns at a compound annual growth rate of 27.3%. Provides enterprise context for budget and tooling investment decisions in GEO.
